title: LR 157
author: Let Us All Rejoice
snippet: Turn your eyes, O God, our shield; and look on the face of your anointed one; One day within your courts is better than a thousand elsewhere.

title: Responsorial Psalm - 20th Sunday OTA
author: Psalm 67: 2-3, 5, 6, 8
snippet: O God, let all the nations praise you!

title: Gospel Acclamation - 20th Sunday OTA
author: Matthew 4:23
snippet: Jesus proclaimed the Gospel of the kingdom and cured every disease among the people

title: Petition
author: Sarah Hart
snippet: O Lord, have mercy on us all, grant us your peace, bring us your healing.

title: LR 158
author: Let Us All Rejoice
snippet: With the Lord there is mercy; In him is plentiful redemption.

title: You Alone
author: Sarah Hart / Dwight Liles
snippet: You alone are holy, you alone are Lord. You alone are worthy to be honored and adored. Mercy you have given, kindness you have shown. Love is you alone.

title: Healed in Christ
author: Sarah Hart
snippet: Father, you are here; holy, this anointing, gift of sweetest comfort in our suffering. God, we are afraid; you restore our courage. Though we are in darkness, bind our wounds with light. We are healed in Christ.

title: Ablaze
author: Ben Walther
snippet: By his grace we are conceived to be mercy, to be peace, to be light amidst the darkness. In his image we are made to be brilliant, to be great, to present the world his likeness.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
